subject: set input values to reference values when another input value changes

messages.author: 71bfb5f1e96782a8
messages.subject: set input values to reference values when another input value changes
parts:
Hi,

i have an app with several tabs. In the first tab the user selects something and then there are several options, which depend on the first choice. I would want to reset all these latter options to default values, when the user changes his first input. The problem is that otherwise there might be some options set, which don't make sense.

Consider the following example: the user selects a dataframe in tab 1, a column in tab 2 and gets the mean in tab 3. when he now selects the other df in tab 1 and doesn't call tab 2 again but jumps to tab3, R throws an error (since the column name set earlier doesn't match the names of the selected df). 

thanks a lot!
felix

runApp(list(
  ui = fluidPage(
    
    # Application title
    titlePanel("Test"),
    
    # Sidebar with a slider input for number of bins
    sidebarLayout(
      sidebarPanel(
        conditionalPanel(condition = "input.Tabs == 'First'", selectInput('df_choice', 'which df', selector)), 
        conditionalPanel(condition = "input.Tabs == 'Second'", uiOutput("cols"))
      ),
      mainPanel(
        tabsetPanel(id = "Tabs",
          tabPanel("First"),
          tabPanel("Second", tableOutput('head')),
          tabPanel("Third", verbatimTextOutput('summary'))
        )
        
      )
    )
  ),
  
  server = function(input, output) {
    selector = c(df1 = "df1", df2 = "df2")
    
    
    daten = reactive({
      dfs = 
        list(
          df1 = data.frame(a = rnorm(10), b = rnorm(10)),
          df2 = data.frame(c = rnorm(10), d = rnorm(10)))
      return(dfs[[input$df_choice]])
    })
    
    avail_choice = reactive({
      avail_choice = names(daten())
      names(avail_choice) = avail_choice    
    })
    
    output$cols = renderUI({
      selectInput("cols", "select cols", avail_choice())
    })
    
    output$head <- renderTable({daten()})
    output$summary <- renderPrint({mean(daten()[,input$cols])})
    }
  
))

1) detect the active tab in an observer 

2) In your reactive conductor daten, first check if the column name is valid; if not, return something else (the mean of the first column, or a custom error message)
